```sql
    WHERE YEAR(sci.CreatedOnUtc) = YEAR(CURDATE())
    GROUP BY
        sci.CustomerId,
        sci.StoreId,

),
completed_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.CustomerId,
        o.StoreId,
        MIN(o.CreatedOnUtc) AS first_order_after_cart,
        DATE(DATE_SUB(o.CreatedOnUtc, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(o.CreatedOnUtc) DAY)) AS week_start
    FROM `Order` o
    WHERE o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40, 50)
      AND YEAR(o.CreatedOnUtc) = YEAR(CURDATE())
    GROUP BY
        o.CustomerId,
        o.StoreId,
        DATE(DATE_SUB(o.CreatedOnUtc, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(o.CreatedOnUtc) DAY))
),
weekly_cart_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        ce.week_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(ce.CustomerId, '-', ce.StoreId)) AS carts_started,
        COUNT(
            DISTINCT CASE 
                WHEN co.CustomerId IS NULL 
                THEN CONCAT(ce.CustomerId, '-', ce.StoreId)
            END
        ) AS abandoned_carts
    FROM cart_events ce
    LEFT JOIN completed_orders co
        ON co.CustomerId = ce.CustomerId
       AND co.StoreId = ce.StoreId

        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(wcm.carts_started, 0) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE (wcm.abandoned_carts / wcm.carts_started) * 100
        END,
        2
    ) AS abandonment_rate_percent,
    ROUND(
        (
            COALESCE(wcm.abandoned_carts, 0) 
            - LAG(COALESCE(wcm.abandoned_carts, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY w.week_start)
        ),
        2
    ) AS wow_abandoned_cart_change,
    ROUND(
        (
            COALESCE(
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN COALESCE(wcm.carts_started, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                        ELSE (wcm.abandoned_carts / wcm.carts_started) * 100
                    END
                ),
                0
            )
            -
            LAG(
                COALESCE(
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN COALESCE(wcm.carts_started, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                            ELSE (wcm.abandoned_carts / wcm.carts_started) * 100
                        END
                    ),
                    0
                )
            ) OVER (ORDER BY w.week_start)
        ),
        2
    ) AS wow_abandonment_rate_change_percent_points
```

```sql
),
cost_data AS (

            WHEN o.Channel = 'Online' THEN 'Online'
            WHEN o.Channel = 'MobileApp' THEN 'Mobile App'
            WHEN o.Channel = 'Marketplace' THEN 'Marketplace'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS sales_channel,
        oi.OrderId,
        SUM(oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.Quantity) AS total_revenue,
        SUM((p.Cost * oi.Quantity)) AS total_product_cost,
        SUM(oi.DiscountAmountInclTax) AS total_discounts
    FROM `OrderItem` oi

    INNER JOIN `Product` p ON p.Id = oi.ProductId
    WHERE o.OrderStatusId = 30
        AND o.Deleted = 0

    GROUP BY oi.OrderId, o.Channel
),
channel_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.sales_channel,

        SUM(sd.OrderSubtotalInclTax) AS subtotal_sales,
        SUM(sd.OrderShippingInclTax) AS total_shipping,

    SELECT
```

```sql
            WHEN po.DiscountAmount > 5 AND po.DiscountAmount <= 20 THEN 'Medium Discount'
            WHEN po.DiscountAmount > 20 AND po.DiscountAmount <= 50 THEN 'Large Discount'
            WHEN po.DiscountAmount > 50 THEN 'Heavy Discount'

        SUM(po.RevenueAfterDiscount) AS TotalNetRevenue,
```

baseline_sql:
```sql
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m-01') AS revenue_month,
        SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPriceInclTax) AS total_revenue
    FROM OrderItem oi
    INNER JOIN `Order` o
        ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
    WHERE o.OrderStatusId IN (20, 30, 40) -- Completed / Processing / Paid statuses
      AND o.Deleted = 0
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m-01')
),
trend_calculation AS (
    SELECT
        revenue_month,
        total_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_month) AS month_index
    FROM monthly_revenue
),
linear_regression AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(month_index) AS sum_x,
        SUM(total_revenue) AS sum_y,
        SUM(month_index * total_revenue) AS sum_xy,
        SUM(month_index * month_index) AS sum_x2
    FROM trend_calculation
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT
        (
            (
                (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) /
                NULLIF((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x), 0)
            )
            *
            (MAX(tc.month_index) + 1)
        )
        +
        (
            (sum_y -
                (
                    (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) /
                    NULLIF((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x), 0)
                ) * sum_x
            ) / n
        ) AS predicted_next_month_revenue
    FROM linear_regression lr
    CROSS JOIN trend_calculation tc
)
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(
        DATE_ADD(MAX(revenue_month), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),
        '%Y-%m'
    ) AS forecast_month,
    ROUND(predicted_next_month_revenue, 2) AS forecast_total_revenue
FROM forecast
CROSS JOIN monthly_revenue;
```

```sql
-- Overall business performance dashboard
-- Assumes nopCommerce tables: Order, OrderItem, Product, Category, Customer, Shipment, Store

    COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS unique_customers,
    SUM(o.OrderTotal) AS gross_revenue,
    AVG(o.OrderTotal) AS average_order_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId = 30 THEN o.OrderTotal ELSE 0 END) AS paid_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId = 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId = 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_orders
FROM `Order` o;

-- Revenue trend by month
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    COUNT(o.Id) AS orders,
    SUM(o.OrderTotal) AS revenue,
    AVG(o.OrderTotal) AS avg_order_value
FROM `Order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;

-- Customer growth and repeat customer performance
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN first_order.order_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_time_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN first_order.order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
    AVG(first_order.order_count) AS avg_orders_per_customer
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.Id AS CustomerId,
        COUNT(o.Id) AS order_count
    FROM Customer c
    LEFT JOIN `Order` o
        ON o.CustomerId = c.Id
        AND o.Deleted = 0
    WHERE c.Deleted = 0
    GROUP BY c.Id

    p.Id AS product_id,
    p.Name AS product_name,
    SUM(oi.Quantity) AS units_sold,
    SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPriceInclTax) AS revenue
FROM OrderItem oi
JOIN Product p
    ON p.Id = oi.ProductId
JOIN `Order` o
    ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY p.Id, p.Name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

    c.Name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.Quantity) AS units_sold,
    SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPriceInclTax) AS revenue
FROM Category c
JOIN Product_Category_Mapping pcm
    ON pcm.CategoryId = c.Id
JOIN Product p
    ON p.Id = pcm.ProductId
JOIN OrderItem oi
    ON oi.ProductId = p.Id

    ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
```
